name: dev-workflows
description: The daily-work arc in one plugin, entered via /daily (hybrid router: bare = 5-station menu — start/work/file/report/wrap — argument jumps straight there; see PLAYBOOK.md at the marketplace repo root). Design & planning: grill-then-plan, and sp-grill-with-doc for the same domain-aware grilling with NO plan hand-off (the grilling-only half; both pose every question in the user terms - screen, press, observe). Debug chain: debug-mantra -> (grill-then-plan when the fix involves a design choice) -> post-mortem -> generating-test-cases (regression case) -> management-talk. Review & verification: scrutinize, review-pr (GitHub PR review — safe workspace, scrutinize as the judge, then send-back / fix-it / chat-only), dual-verifier. Testing & QA: generating-test-cases (evidence-grounded test-case suites for a feature/change/fixed bug, rendered to Excel/Markdown/CSV or delegated to a tracker). Documents: sa-doc (full SA&D document — use cases, diagrams, data dictionary, architecture — generated from one validated model; Markdown canonical, PDF optional). document-what-shipped (/dev-workflows:document-what-shipped - ONE page per run about something that already ships: a user manual, a process-and-flow page, a release note, a runbook or a rules page. Every fact is measured in three places - authored code, the platform own automation, and a live record - and a fact no place answers goes on the not-built list instead of the page. A numbered shot list is handed over before drafting, and the gate opens only on an explicit answer (files, or a plain no images / the diagram is enough). The run stops at the draft; only the owner says publish. Publishes to an Azure DevOps wiki, a GitHub wiki, a repo docs folder or a plain markdown folder, and an adapter for a new destination is measured on its first run rather than guessed. Manual invocation only). System study: study-design-verify, fit-gap-analysis, naming-audit, drive-to-legacy, crm-archaeology (Dynamics 365/Dataverse org study), ticket-trace. Communication: management-talk, invoice-generator (Tribletext daily summary from git commits), problem-description (interactive HTML walkthroughs), feynman-explain (/feynman — any "what is this / how does it work" answered as a capped four-step card: plain explanation, the fuzzy parts named, gaps filled from real evidence with citations, 30-second line; the cure for long unformatted answers), wait-what (/wait-what — the one-line repair for a message that did not land: re-pitch it with a little context, in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, using CONTEXT.md's ubiquitous language. Vendored verbatim from mattpocock/skills under MIT, see LICENSE-mattpocock-skills; disable-model-invocation is true, so it runs only when the user asks). Growth: career-growth (quarterly career review — evidence-graded inventory, live market + certificate survey, four-test moat, cert-driven mini-project plan). Understanding & handover: asking-to-understand (/ask - the Socratic side of feynman-explain: when the user wants to be ASKED rather than told, or owns an artifact an AI built that they do not understand - one evidence-grounded question per turn, answers classified, symptom pushed to mechanism, closes when they state the rule themselves). Reflection: reflect (session retrospective that routes each lesson into an owned skill, a CLAUDE.md, a cross-project GOTCHAS.md, or memory — closing the daily arc with a learn beat). Hand-work runbooks: guide-and-verify (for a change that is the user's to make by hand in a console the agent cannot write to - CRM, cloud portal, DNS, SaaS admin, CI settings, a database GUI: measure the live baseline before writing a single instruction, snapshot the full serialized before-state of every object a step will touch and not only the numbers it will assert, separate the raw match count from what the person must actually click, hand over Go to / Do / Do not / verify-yourself steps one at a time, then prove it landed read-only in a channel other than the one they edited in. Carries the saved-is-not-applied trap that catches nearly every system, and the honest fallbacks for when there is no second channel or you cannot read the system at all). Advisory on external facts: verify-then-advise (verify vendor products / certifications / SKUs against retirement registries, hunt a counter-signal, count primary artifacts before citing commentary, and grade every claim by confidence before recommending). Superpowers vendoring: the six sp- skills (sp-brainstorming, sp-writing-plans, sp-executing-plans, sp-subagent-driven-development, sp-requesting-code-review, sp-receiving-code-review) are vendored from obra/superpowers under MIT and MODIFIED so that where a review step dispatches, it routes to this plugin's scrutinize-dispatch engine; see LICENSE-superpowers.
